description: Perform a click or fill action on a page element in an active browser session. Use "click" to click buttons, links, checkboxes, or any clickable element by CSS selector. Use "fill" to type text into input fields, textareas, or contenteditable elements — pass the target CSS selector and the text value in params. Requires an active session created by the navigate tool. Do not use this for navigation — use the navigate tool instead.

action.description: "click" to click an element, "fill" to type text into an input field

params.description: Action parameters. For click: {"selector": "button.submit"}. For fill: {"selector": "input[name=email]", "value": "user@example.com"}.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element

value.description: Text to type into the element (fill action only)

session_id.description: Browser session ID from a previous navigate call

name: interact
